description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19,999. Grants [Crystal Force Mode] to user, [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode: Alisaie] to self. Grants [Attach Wind with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking] based on if entry damage was Wind/Lightning.

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Alisaie
description.text: Black Magic/White Magic abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Black Magic/White Magic abilities trigger 1 additional time, [DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)], removed if user hasn't Crystal Force Mode

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3
